title: The Blank Interrogation

features.name: the central mark
features.desc-on-touch: A question rendered in space. The archive interrogates the interrogation that interrogates the archive.

features.name: open space
features.desc-on-touch: The architecture of whiteness. Where an answer should be, there is only air and the echo of the question.

features.name: reflection chamber
features.desc-on-touch: You see yourself asking. The interrogation is recursive. The margin reflects the centre. Nothing answers.

features.name: suspended proof
features.desc-on-touch: Evidence that the interrogation happened. But of what, or to what, or by what? The blank refutes all naming.

features.name: margin annotation
features.desc-on-touch: Where the archive has written in the margins of itself. The writing is in an ink the archive hasn't learned to read.

inscription: the interrogation asks only itself; the answer space is open in all directions and empty in all of them

file.name: Archive_Self_Interrogation_Transcript_Incomplete.txt
file.note: Questions without questioners. Responses that refuse the grammar of question-answer. The archive's most unsettling file.

exits.label: back to the question that asks the asking of itself
into whitespace where emptiness has opinions
upward where questions begin to echo
